estimates.rationale: Single domain entity (stock record) with basic CRUD, unique constraint on (SKU, location), form submission, and index view. Foundational but straightforward implementation.

Optimistic in-place update requiring frontend state management, backend validation (no-negative per R2), and auditing (timestamp+actor per R1). Coordination between optimistic UI and server validation adds complexity.

New receipt entity with supplier attribution and orchestrated stock adjustment. Introduces new inbound event type and business logic mapping receipt to stock mutation, comparable architectural scope to FP2.

New pick entity with overcommit validation (read-compare-write atomicity per R2) and stock draw-down. Introduces outbound event type with critical business constraint enforcement, comparable scope to FP3.
SKU-level aggregation query and detail view listing multiple location rows for one SKU. No new domain logic or entities; primarily a query and UI view concern leveraging existing stock structure.
